text:
Type: black metal stacking stool
Use: extra seating, quick perch, side surface; dining room, kitchen, home office, hallway
Style: minimalist, industrial, modern
Materials: black powder-coated steel legs, molded plastic seat with round holes
Colors: matte black
Shape: round flat seat dotted with round holes, four straight slim tube legs angling slightly outward, stackable, compact and light
Feel: simple, graphic, casual, practical
Goes with: white walls, light or dark wood, concrete, black accents; industrial, minimalist or modern kitchens and studios

product.name: MARIUS
product.description: The stool can be stacked, so you can keep several on hand and store them on the same space as one.
